headline: Aakash Exploration Services: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Aakash Exploration Services Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares by an acquirer; identity and deal value remain undisclosed in the primary filing.
detail: Aakash Exploration Services Limited submitted to NSE a statutory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011-the mandatory announcement required once an acquirer reaches or exceeds 25% of equity. The disclosure filing signals an active takeover event but does not specify the acquirer identity, number of shares acquired, or transaction value in the public extract. The company is now bound by the 60-day open offer timeline unless an exemption applies.
